text:
sam_m: Heads up — nightly CI shows ~18% p95 regression on decode after the fused-op rework merge (r=0xabc123). Canary also reproduces.
ci-bot: CI job https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/eng-runtime/3456 failed: perf/regression/p95 > threshold. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/nightly/1733337777/ (flamegraphs, traces) :warning:
jia: copying artifacts now. can you paste the failing test name and invocation?
sam_m: repro script: `./dev/run_perf.py --model redwood-3b --profile --batch-sizes 1,4 --seq-lens 16,128` — failing test is decode_tail_latency.test_shortseq
rob: quick flamegraph excerpt (top symbols):
```
decode_step
 fused_attention_forward
 kv_cache_prefetch
 matmul_quantized
```
rob: flamegraph link: s3://perf-artifacts/nightly/1733337777/flame.svg
leo: metrics show KV cache miss rate jumped x6 around the merge time. snippet from metrics: `kv_miss_rate: 0.012 -> 0.073` between 1733300000 and 1733337777
maria: if KV prefetch is being penalized by fused-op changes that could explain per-token spikes. Do we have a candidate commit range to bisect?
sam_m: suspect range: 0xabc100..0xabc200 (the fused-op rework PR touched prefetch ordering). I'll bisect. Assigning: jia do perf runs, rob grab traces, leo look at cache counters.
jia: running bisect job #1 now (shortseq, batch=1). Will upload results in ~15m.
rob: local quick repro shows stepping pattern — per-token latency spikes every ~8 tokens. psuedolog: `token=8: 6.2ms -> token=9: 14.8ms -> token=10: 6.3ms`
leo: correlating trace IDs with cache logs — when spike happens there are synchronous KV fetches falling back to slower path (no prefetch hit). Looks like fused attention reordering delayed issuing prefetch for the next chunk.
ops-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 > SLO for service 'redwood-inference-hosted' — rollout blocked, auto-rollback disabled.
maria: given impact we should rollback the fused-op change if bisect points to it. Post a revert PR and notify infra.
sam_m: bisect result: commit 0xabc123 introduced a reorder in fused attention that moved prefetch calls after compute scheduling. Reverting that single hunk recovers baseline in local perf.
jia: bisect perf numbers: baseline p95=72ms, after 0xabc123 p95=86ms, after revert p95=73ms. KV miss rate back to 0.013. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/bisect/1733337777/results.json
rob: trace after revert shows prefetch calls happen ~2 tokens earlier — KV latency now amortized into next token, no spike.
maria: OK let's cut revert PR (owner: sam_m). Also add a regression test that runs shortseq decode under fused and non-fused paths in CI.
sam_m: PR created: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/pulls/789 (revert hunk from 0xabc123). Rolling back canary now.
ops-bot: Rollout status: canary rollback initiated. Notifying oncall.
sam_m: after canary rollback p95 back to 74ms — within noise. Closing rollout block.
maria: follow-up items: (1) add CI perf test for shortseq decode, (2) write a small microbenchmark for prefetch ordering, (3) owner to propose a corrected fused-op rework that preserves prefetch ordering.
rob: I'll draft the microbenchmark and leave notes in the PR.
jia: I'll add the CI job and wire artifact upload.
leo: I'll add dashboard panel for kv_prefetch_latency and kv_prefetch_issues.
sam_m: thanks everyone. tagging owners: @rob @jia @leo for follow-ups. will schedule a postmortem doc later. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — nice quick bisect.
